reverie.title: REVERIE — kneeling at the root where she first touched the a
narr: You kneel where the old tree's roots break the red earth.
She kneels across from you. Her hand touches the bark.
She says: this is how it learns. This is how *we* learn.
The root is not reaching upward. It is teaching downward.
You feel the soil's grammar moving through your hands.
She says: becoming means moving without seeing where you go.
